tips.text: Join a finished clan from recruiting chat instead of building one; most already have the Tenno Lab researched.
Start the 48 hour research first and farm the build materials while it runs.
Start new research only in a small clan; the cost multiplies with the clan's size, up to 100 times.
Pick a clan with an active leader; in a dormant one you may lack the permission to start research.
Treat it as a starter weapon people grab early from the lab; nobody complains about getting it.
